findings.title: 5 Palestinians injured in storm-related collapses as heavy rains batter Gaza displacement tents
findings.affected_population_system: Five injured Palestinians, including two women, in wall and corrugated-metal collapses
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical sources told Anadolu that five Palestinians, including two women, were injured in separate incidents involving the collapse of two walls and the fall of a sheet of corrugated metal in northern and central Gaza.
findings.source_type: Established news report citing Gaza medical sources; direct interview with Civil Defence spokesperson

bounded_discovery_context.previously_logged: Two rain-related injuries in a northern Gaza wall collapse; prior Gaza Source Watch heartbeat 07:44 PST
bounded_discovery_context.distinct_increment: Five injured now reported; at least a higher attributed total, but overlap and exact extra incident times unverified
bounded_discovery_context.search_method: targeted search followed by direct Anadolu Middle East index and linked article

findings.title: Gaza Civil Defence reports 2,166 storm distress calls, 218 responses and four storm-related damaged-home collapses
findings.location: Gaza Strip; identified responses at Nuseirat, Bureij and central Gaza City
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced civilians, flood emergency response system, residents of damaged buildings
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Separately, Gaza’s Civil Defense said it had received 2,166 distress calls since the storm began Friday evening. Crews were able to respond to only 218 as rainwater flooded dozens of displacement camps and shelters, as well as entire residential areas.
findings.source_type: Established news reporting direct Gaza Civil Defence operational figures

bounded_discovery_context.previously_logged: 1,500 distress calls in 10 hours; Nuseirat evacuation and flood response in 04:44 predecessor; earlier Reuters noted three abandoned home collapses
bounded_discovery_context.distinct_increment: Updated cumulative volume 2,166 calls, 218 attended; named Bureij roof and Gaza City court-district building collapses are additional detail, may overlap earlier collapses

findings.title: Al-Shifa emergency department flooded and temporarily out of service
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Mohammed Abu Salmiya, director of al-Shifa Medical Complex in Gaza City, told Al Jazeera that the hospital’s emergency department flooded and was out of service for about four hours.
findings.source_type: Established news report directly attributing account to hospital director

bounded_discovery_context.previously_logged: Flooded tents, evacuation and emergency services recorded earlier; no al-Shifa emergency-department disruption in latest watch heartbeat
bounded_discovery_context.distinct_increment: Specific reported temporary hospital-functioning interruption; recovery after the four-hour interruption not independently verified
bounded_discovery_context.search_method: targeted Al Jazeera November 7 search and direct original article

findings.title: OCHA warns Gaza emergency winter stocks insufficient as responders mobilize
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced families in flooded shelters; humanitarian stocks, vehicles and generators
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Humanitarian organizations have mobilized to distribute emergency supplies and assist affected families, but available stocks remain "insufficient," OCHA warned.
findings.source_type: Established reporting of attributable official OCHA humanitarian statement

bounded_discovery_context.previously_logged: Storm flooding and pre-existing shelter-material restrictions known, but November 7 OCHA response and current insufficient emergency supplies not in latest watch heartbeat
bounded_discovery_context.distinct_increment: Operational response and supply sufficiency statement, not an independently quantified new aid disruption
bounded_discovery_context.search_method: direct Anadolu publisher index linked article; OCHA OPT site has no November 7 written situation report
